name: MemeTastic
blurb: 😌 Simple Meme Creator - Completly ad-free and adds no watermarks.
description:
😌 Simple Meme Creator - Completly ad-free and adds no watermarks.

Memes can be created from image templates in MemeTastic pictures folder,
from pictures shared into the app and pictures from gallery & camera.
No internet connection required or used.

There are many meme customization options available:

😄 Top & bottom caption
😃 Font & border text color
😁 Text size, font and capitalization
😃 Padding size & color
😜 Rotate picture

More Features:
👓 Show saved memes & favorites
👉 Share into any app accepting pictures

Support the project:
✋ Translate using Stringlate
✋ Join discussion on Matrix
✋ More information about contributions
